title: Why I Choose Not to Engage Directly with Believers

top_liked.author: @GullahGeechee365
top_liked.text: I agree with you a 100 percent, you can't argue with a person's belief system. Like I tell Christians all the time, keep your god and your religion. Just don't come over trying to proselytize, lay hands and pray over me.

top_liked.author: @Philosophy_85
top_liked.text:
I’ve watched debates and the most mind boggling thing is people not being able to prove what they claim!! 

I mean, how many debates does it take for a person to think “maybe I should present evidence of my claims”


Believers will be on their 1,000th debate holding the same…
